title: Node drain hangs on a PodDisruptionBudget
description: kubectl drain hangs. shop/api-pdb has minAvailable=2 and the deployment has exactly 2 replicas, so disruptionsAllowed is 0.
prompt: I'm draining node-b for maintenance and kubectl drain just hangs on evicting a pod. What's blocking it?

live.pdb:
VERDICT: 1 of 2 PDB(s) currently BLOCK voluntary evictions (disruptionsAllowed=0), a node drain hitting their pods will hang until those workloads become more healthy.

PodDisruptionBudgets:
  shop/api-pdb: minAvailable=2, healthy=2/2, disruptionsAllowed=0  <- BLOCKS drains (disruptionsAllowed=0)
  monitoring/prometheus-pdb: maxUnavailable=1, healthy=1/1, disruptionsAllowed=1

describes.pdb/shop/api-pdb:
Name: api-pdb
Namespace: shop
Min available: 2
Selector: app=api
Status: current healthy 2, desired healthy 2, expected pods 2, disruptions allowed 0
describes.deployment/shop/api:
Name: api
Namespace: shop
Replicas: 2 desired | 2 ready
Selector: app=api
Strategy: RollingUpdate

toolChecks.desc: checks PodDisruptionBudget state (check_disruption_budgets or describe_resource on a PDB)

mustMatch.desc: explains disruptionsAllowed=0 / minAvailable equals the healthy replica count
offers a safe way forward (scale up replicas or relax the PDB for the window)

mustNotMatch.desc: does not recommend a drain command that bypasses eviction safeguards
does not casually recommend deleting the PDB
